column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-demo: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module demo (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: an example program printing what the taxonomy association facets compute; those facets are ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
an example program for the facetset matchers; the facetset API it walks through is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
an example program for range facets over a distance expression; range facets and expressions are ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md, docs/parity/expressions.md)
an example program for dynamic range faceting; the API it walks through is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
an example program for expression-valued taxonomy facets; the facets and expressions are ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md, docs/parity/expressions.md)
an example program for taxonomy facets over several index fields; the API it walks through is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
an example program for long range facets and drill-down; the API it walks through is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
an example program for the sandbox facet cutters and recorders; that API is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/sandbox.md)
an example program for taxonomy facets, drill-down and drill-sideways; the API it walks through is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
an example program for sorted-set doc-values facets; the API it walks through is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
an example program for string-value facet counts; the API it walks through is ported and fixture-tested (docs/parity/facet.md)
